Hello, Master ji? Main Sunita bol rahi h.text: Sunita Bansal says hello and identifies herself as calling from Model Town, and says the worker made her daughter-in-law's suit last year.
Hello, Master ji? Main Sunita bol rahi h.quote: Hello, Master ji? Main Sunita bol rahi hoon, Bansal, Model Town wali. Pichhle saal aapne meri bahu ka suit banaya tha.

Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah De.text: Sunita says the job is to make a lehenga blouse and some suits for her daughter's wedding.
Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah De.quote: Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah December ko. Uska kaam karwana hai aapse. Lehenga ka blouse aur kuch suits.

Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah De.text: Sunita says the wedding is on 12 December.
Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah De.quote: Master ji, beti ki shaadi hai, baarah December ko. Uska kaam karwana hai aapse. Lehenga ka blouse aur kuch suits.

Mubarak ho ji, bahut mubarak. Kitne suit.text: Iqbal Ansari congratulates her and asks how many suits.
Mubarak ho ji, bahut mubarak. Kitne suit.quote: Mubarak ho ji, bahut mubarak. Kitne suit?

Chaar suit. Aur lehenga ka blouse, aur l.text: Sunita Bansal says the job is four suits, plus a lehenga blouse and lehenga fitting, and that she will provide all the cloth.
Chaar suit. Aur lehenga ka blouse, aur l.value: four suits, lehenga blouse, lehenga fitting, customer provides cloth
Chaar suit. Aur lehenga ka blouse, aur l.quote: Chaar suit. Aur lehenga ka blouse, aur lehenga ki fitting bhi. Kapda sab mera hai, main de jaungi.

Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.text: The worker says blouse and lehenga stitching will cost 4,500 rupees, and the four suits will cost 4,800 rupees.
Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.value: 4,500 rupees for blouse and lehenga stitching; 4,800 rupees for four suits
Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.quote: Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki silai saade chaar hazaar, aur suit baarah sau ek, chaar ke hue adtaalis sau.

Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.text: The worker says the lining should be brought by the hirer and that he does not keep it.
Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.value: lining to be brought by the hirer
Theek. Dekhiye, blouse aur lehenga ki si.quote: Lining aap le aana, woh main nahi rakhta.

Arre baap re, nau hazaar teen sau? Maste.text: Sunita Bansal says the total is 9,300 rupees.
Arre baap re, nau hazaar teen sau? Maste.quote: Arre baap re, nau hazaar teen sau? Master ji, itna to nahi. Pichhli baar to aapne...

Pichhli baar ek suit tha, Bansal ji. Ye.text: The worker says last time it was one suit, and this is bridal work with handwork in the blouse.
Pichhli baar ek suit tha, Bansal ji. Ye.quote: Pichhli baar ek suit tha, Bansal ji. Ye bridal kaam hai, blouse mein haath ka kaam lagega.

Achha suniye, aath hazaar kar lijiye sab.text: Sunita Bansal offers 8,000 rupees for the whole job.
Achha suniye, aath hazaar kar lijiye sab.quote: Achha suniye, aath hazaar kar lijiye sab.

Aath mein nahi hoga ji. Haan, nau hazaar.text: The worker says the job will be 9,000 rupees.
Aath mein nahi hoga ji. Haan, nau hazaar.quote: Aath mein nahi hoga ji. Haan, nau hazaar kar deta hoon, round figure.

Nau hazaar... saara saaman milake na? La.text: Sunita Bansal asks whether the 9,000 rupees is for everything including all materials and accessories.
Nau hazaar... saara saaman milake na? La.quote: Nau hazaar... saara saaman milake na? Latkan, dori, sab?

Haan ji, saaman milake. Latkan to main a.text: The worker says the job includes materials together with the work, and that he will add good latkans sourced from Chandni Chowk.
Haan ji, saaman milake. Latkan to main a.value: materials included; good latkans from Chandni Chowk
Haan ji, saaman milake. Latkan to main a.quote: Haan ji, saaman milake. Latkan to main achhe wale lagata hoon, Chandni Chowk se laata hoon.

Theek hai, theek hai. Accha, trial kab h.text: Sunita Bansal accepts the 9,000 rupees price.
Sunita Bansal asks when the trial will be.

Kapda kal parson de jaiye, to trial agle.text: The worker says the cloth should be given tomorrow or the day after, the trial is next Sunday, and the full outfit will be ready by December 5.
Kapda kal parson de jaiye, to trial agle.value: give cloth tomorrow or the day after; trial next Sunday; ready by December 5
Kapda kal parson de jaiye, to trial agle.quote: Kapda kal parson de jaiye, to trial agle Sunday ko, aur poora maal paanch December tak ready.

Paanch tak? Shaadi baarah ko hai... haan.text: The hirer accepts the worker's finish date of 5 December and says one week before that will allow time for alterations.
Paanch tak? Shaadi baarah ko hai... haan.quote: Paanch tak? Shaadi baarah ko hai... haan, theek hai, ek hafta pehle mil jayega to alteration ka time rahega.

Bilkul. Koi dheela tight hua to wahin th.text: The worker says if anything is loose or tight, they will fix it there on the spot.
Bilkul. Koi dheela tight hua to wahin th.value: free fix for loose or tight work
Bilkul. Koi dheela tight hua to wahin th.quote: Bilkul. Koi dheela tight hua to wahin theek kar denge.

Paise ka batayiye, advance kitna?.text: Sunita Bansal asks how much advance there will be.

Jo aap theek samjhein. Aadha de dijiye..text: The worker says the hirer can pay half as advance.
Jo aap theek samjhein. Aadha de dijiye..quote: Jo aap theek samjhein. Aadha de dijiye.

Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.text: The hirer says she cannot pay half now and will pay 2,000 rupees now by PhonePe.
Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.quote: Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke kharche hain. Do hazaar abhi PhonePe kar deti hoon, baaki jab maal uthaungi tab.

Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.text: The hirer says the बाकी will be paid when she picks up the goods.
Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.value: when I pick up the goods
Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke.quote: Aadha to abhi nahi ho payega, shaadi ke kharche hain. Do hazaar abhi PhonePe kar deti hoon, baaki jab maal uthaungi tab.

Chaliye koi baat nahi. Do hazaar sahi ha.text: The worker says 2,000 rupees is okay as the advance.
Chaliye koi baat nahi. Do hazaar sahi ha.quote: Chaliye koi baat nahi. Do hazaar sahi hai.

Chaliye koi baat nahi. Do hazaar sahi ha.text: The worker says the rest will be paid when the hirer picks up the goods.
Chaliye koi baat nahi. Do hazaar sahi ha.value: when I pick up the goods
Chaliye koi baat nahi. Do hazaar sahi ha.quote: Chaliye koi baat nahi. Do hazaar sahi hai.

Aur Master ji, ek baat. Agar paanch tak.text: Sunita Bansal says that if it is not ready by the 5th, and mentions the worker was three days late at Diwali last time.
Aur Master ji, ek baat. Agar paanch tak.quote: Aur Master ji, ek baat. Agar paanch tak ready nahi hua to? Pichhli baar Diwali pe aapne teen din late kiya tha.

Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore h.text: The worker says the power was out for a whole week last time and says it will not happen this time, asking Sunita Bansal not to worry.
Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore h.quote: Arre woh to bijli chali gayi thi poore hafte. Is baar nahi hoga, aap tension mat lo. Pachchees saal se kaam kar raha hoon.

Haan wo to hai. Accha, beti ka naap aap.text: The hirer asks whether the worker will take the daughter's measurements or manage using an old blouse.
Haan wo to hai. Accha, beti ka naap aap.quote: Haan wo to hai. Accha, beti ka naap aap loge ya purane blouse se kaam chal jayega?

Beti ko le aaiye ek baar, bridal mein pu.text: The worker says the daughter should be brought once, because bridal work cannot be done from the old measurements and the measurements need to be taken correctly.
Beti ko le aaiye ek baar, bridal mein pu.quote: Beti ko le aaiye ek baar, bridal mein purane naap se nahi chalta. Naap sahi lena padta hai.

Gawah ji, aap sun rahe ho na? Maine adva.text: Sunita Bansal recalls that the advance was two thousand rupees.
Gawah ji, aap sun rahe ho na? Maine adva.quote: Gawah ji, aap sun rahe ho na? Maine advance kitna bola, do hazaar hi na? Baad mein main bhool jaati hoon.

Chalo. Accha Master ji, Pinky ke lehenge.text: The hirer says that if you see Pinky's lehenga, you will be happy because it is maroon.
Chalo. Accha Master ji, Pinky ke lehenge.quote: Chalo. Accha Master ji, Pinky ke lehenge ka rang dekhoge to khush ho jaoge. Mehroon hai.

Achha ji. Mehroon pe golden latkan bahut.text: The worker says maroon lehenga will suit with golden latkans.
Achha ji. Mehroon pe golden latkan bahut.quote: Achha ji. Mehroon pe golden latkan bahut jachega.

Haan haan. Aur suno, uski saas bhi ek ta.text: The hirer says they told the other tailor, "no, our Master ji will do it," because they want this worker to do the job.
Haan haan. Aur suno, uski saas bhi ek ta.quote: Haan haan. Aur suno, uski saas bhi ek tailor jaanti hain Lajpat Nagar mein, par maine kaha nahi ji, hamare Master ji hi karenge.

Meherbani aapki. Bas kapda jaldi pahunch.text: The worker asks Sunita Bansal to deliver the cloth जल्दी.
Meherbani aapki. Bas kapda jaldi pahunch.quote: Meherbani aapki. Bas kapda jaldi pahuncha dijiye.

Kal pakka. Kal shaam ko Pinky ke papa ch.text: Sunita Bansal says the cloth will be brought tomorrow evening.
Kal pakka. Kal shaam ko Pinky ke papa ch.quote: Kal pakka. Kal shaam ko Pinky ke papa chhod jayenge. Chalo phir, rakhti hoon.

Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath.text: The hirer says lining will also be sent along, or asks whether the worker will bring it.
Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath.quote: Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath mein... ya aap le aaoge? Chalo kal dekh lenge. Namaste.

Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath.text: The hirer says they will see tomorrow.
Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath.quote: Haan, aur lining bhi bhijwa dungi saath mein... ya aap le aaoge? Chalo kal dekh lenge. Namaste.
